headline: We both confessed we didn't know what we wanted. But even in logic, one NULL is never equal to another.
caption:
We both confessed we didn't know what we wanted. But even in logic, one NULL is never equal to another.

—
NULL: unknown; not equal to anything, not even to another NULL.
